updates.name: As a Metro by T-Mobile authorized dealer, I want an accessory added to a new phone activation to add its own Prepaid Tax and price to one correct total to collect
updates.custom_requirements:
## What this test is about
In a Metro by T-Mobile store, the rep (the dealer's employee at the counter) activates new phone lines and can also sell accessories on the same order, such as a case or a speaker. Some stores charge a second tax on top of the ordinary sales tax. It is called Prepaid Tax, and it appears on the screen as PP Tax. The rep must be able to see it as its own amount, never mixed into the sales tax, and the amount the customer is asked to pay must include it. This test activates one new phone line, then adds one accessory at the Add accessories step that comes just before payment. It proves the accessory's own Prepaid Tax is added to the phone's, so the order's PP Tax row grows, and that the payment screen asks for the phone order plus the accessory in one total. It stops before any payment is taken, so the phone, SIM and accessory can be used again.

## Related tickets
RTPL-3031 (Implement Prepaid Tax (PP Tax) Calculation)

## Preconditions
- The rep is signed in at store EZLOGIC and the environment shown in the user menu reads UAT2.
- No other sale or activation is open on this till. If one is, cancel it before beginning.
- The till has no customer tablet paired to it.
- The phone and SIM below have not been used by a finished sale.

## Test data
- **Store:** Store EZLOGIC, dealer code 30247306  _(verified: UAT2 2026-10-23, shown in the page header after sign-in)_
- **New customer:** Name PPT TESTER; email: type a brand-new address each run, for example qa.pptax.<today's date and time>@mailinator.com; address 405 LEXINGTON AVE, zip 10174 (city NEW YORK, state fills in as NY); PIN 628193; ID check phone 2125551234  _(verified: UAT2 2026-10-23, the account was created and the ID check passed with these values)_
- **Phone to activate:** IMEI 999939179340536 (dealer stock, SKU 610214688811), device price $229.99, sales tax $23.00, PP Tax $2.30, device line $255.29  _(verified: UAT2 2026-10-23, accepted at the IMEI step; cart read Device $255.29, PP Tax $2.30)_
- **SIM card:** ICCID 8901260000084313223F  _(verified: UAT2 2026-10-23, accepted at the SIM step; cart read SIM card $0.00)_
- **Plan:** MAU55, $60.00 per month (pre-selected on the Plan selection screen)  _(verified: UAT2 2026-10-23, cart read Plan (MAU55) $60.00 / mo.)_
- **Accessory to add:** Item number BITTYVENOM, Bitty Boomers MARVEL VENOM Bluetooth Speaker, price $19.99, sales tax $2.00, PP Tax $0.20, final price $22.19  _(verified: UAT2 2026-10-23, typed into the Scan or type item # box; the Cart read $22.19 for the line and PP Tax rose from $2.30 to $2.50)_

## Automation Notes
- If the phone or SIM is refused or the amounts differ from this ticket, try the next phone and SIM from the UAT2 data sheet and re-read the Cart. If you still cannot get working data, contact the manual QA team to help get working data - do not sit blocked and do not hunt for data alone.
- Never click Collect amount or Submit order. The test ends before any payment is taken.
- CONFIRM BEFORE AUTOMATING: the PP Tax amounts are what this store charged on 2026-10-23 (1% of each item's price: $2.30 on the $229.99 phone and $0.20 on the $19.99 accessory). If the store's rate or the prices have changed, re-read the Cart at the SIM validation step and after the accessory is added, and update the figures.
- In this walk the Promotion selection offered a $55 Device Rebate and it was declined. The Cart showed the same Device $255.29 and Total due $315.29 before and after the decision, so the rebate has no visible effect on the price. Ask the manual QA team if that is expected.

steps.expected: The dashboard opens and the header shows STORE ID EZLOGIC and DEALER CODE 30247306.

steps.action: On the dashboard, click the New account tile
steps.expected: The screen opens with the heading NEW ACCOUNT and a form headed Account information with First name, Middle initial, Last name, Email, Address, Address 2, Zip code, City, State, SIM block, PIN, Confirm PIN and three Security question and Answer pairs. The Cart on the right shows Account with no lines.

steps.action: Fill in the customer's first name, last name, email, address, zip code and city
steps.expected: The State box fills in by itself with NY after the zip code is typed.

steps.action: Type the PIN twice, choose three different security questions and type an answer for each
steps.expected: The Continue button becomes available.
The message Adding account... shows briefly, then the heading changes to ID verification with a form showing the customer's name and email and a Phone box.

steps.action: Type the phone number into the Phone box and click Continue
steps.expected: A screen reads Congratulations, your customer's ID has been verified. followed by Your customer qualifies for the best promotional pricing whenever available. and an ID Verification Reference # and a Continue button.
The heading changes to IMEI validation and asks to Enter the IMEI of the device to verify network compatibility and inventory.

steps.action: Type the phone's IMEI into the IMEI box
steps.expected: The message Processing request... shows briefly. The heading then changes to SIM validation and reads The device is physical SIM compatible. Confirm your IMEI and SIM card pair below, then click continue. with IMEI 1 - PSIM selected. The Cart now lists the IMEI with Device $255.29, PP Tax $2.30 and Total due $255.29.

steps.action: Type the SIM's ICCID into the ICCID SIM box and click Continue
steps.expected: The heading changes to Phone number selection. The Cart now also lists SIM card $0.00, and still shows PP Tax $2.30 and Total due $255.29.

steps.action: Under Phone number NPA NXX, click Select, then click the first number in the list
steps.expected: A window headed Phone number npa nxx lists numbers such as (347) 499-* NWYRCYZN05, NY. After clicking the first one the window closes and the NPA NXX box shows it.

The heading changes to Protection selection and lists Metro Complete Protection, Metro Advanced Protection, Metro Basic Protection, Metro Complete Loss Theft, Metro Advanced Loss Theft and Metro Basic Loss Theft, with Skip and Continue buttons. The Cart now shows Phone number (347) 499-****.
A window headed Decline all protection options? asks Are you sure you want to decline protection? with the buttons Yes, continue and Back.

The heading changes to Plan selection with MAU55 ($60.00 per month) already marked Selected. The Cart shows Protection Declined and Plan (MAU55) $60.00 / mo., Estimated monthly $60.00 and Total due $315.29, with PP Tax still $2.30.
The heading changes to Promotion selection and reads Great news, customer is eligible for 1 promotions with a card $55 Device Rebate (COUP_NEUVQ4) and Decline and Continue buttons.

steps.action: On the Promotion selection screen click Decline
steps.expected: A window headed Decline all promotions and continue? asks Decline available promotions? This customer is eligible for promotional offers. The device will be sold at full price if none are applied. with the buttons Continue and Back.
The heading changes to Add on services. The Cart still shows Device $255.29, PP Tax $2.30 and Total due $315.29.
A window headed Create subscriber reads Great job configuring IMEI 999939179340536. Click create subscriber to continue. with the buttons Create subscriber and Back.

After a short wait a window headed Subscriber created asks Would you like to add another line to the order, or view Charge Summary and checkout? with the buttons Add another line and Continue to order summary.

The heading changes to Order summary. Under Due Immediately it lists an Order ID, an Account number, Lines in order 1, Device Activation Fee $10.00, Regulatory Fee Recovery $1.54, Total MRC $60.00, Total taxes & fees $11.54, Total PP Tax $2.30 and Edge due immediately $71.54. Below it are the SOS form language choices English and Español and a Metro bill payment amount box. The Cart now reads Taxes & fees $11.54, PP Tax $2.30, Estimated monthly $61.54 and Total due $326.83.
The heading changes to Add accessories with Scan accessory item and Browse accessories. The Cart reads Inventory $0.00, PP Tax $2.30 and Total due $326.83.

steps.action: Click the Scan or type item # box, type the accessory's item number and press Enter
steps.expected: The invoice lists one line, Bitty Boomers MARVEL VENOM Bluetooth Speaker $22.19. The Cart reads Inventory $22.19, PP Tax $2.50 - the phone's $2.30 plus the accessory's $0.20 - and Total due $349.02, which is the phone order's $326.83 plus the accessory's $22.19.
A window headed Financing opens reading Congratulations, financing is available! with Affirm and SmartPay and the buttons Continue and No thanks.
A window headed Decline Financing asks Are you sure you want to continue this payment without a financing loan? with the buttons Decline and Go back.

The heading changes to Collect payment from customer and reads Collect $349.02 with cash, card, or split the payment across multiple methods. The Pay with choices are Cash, Debit card and Credit card and the Amount box reads 349.02. The Cart lists the phone line $326.83 and Inventory $22.19, and reads Customer payments $0.00, Cash $0.00, PP Tax $2.50, Total due $349.02, Total collected $0.00, Balance due $349.02 and Change due back to customer $0.00, with a Collect amount button and a greyed-out Submit order button. Below the Cart is the line Receipt: English, small, Quantity 1 - Edit Settings.

steps.action: Stop here - do NOT click Collect amount and do NOT click Submit order
steps.expected: Nothing further is checked.
